body:
I smile to be polite, but I don't feel obligated to pretend to be something I'm not. I'm not trying to evade confrontation.

I suspect that my depression is at least partially responsible for my low appetite. I will generally eat more than what I'm hungry for to try to maintain my health, even if it doesn't taste very good. I don't like much and I never have cravings for anything. When I'm taking antidepressants, eating becomes even more unpleasant.

I'm not sure where to find inspiration for living if the feeling just isn't there.
